description: Pull one described sound out of your video, like "keyboard clicks", "camera shutter" or "page turning", and split it into single effects to hear, trim and save. Use the video already in the chat: put its file id or name in video_url; never ask for it again. Give the sound in a few words, and start_seconds and end_seconds when the person says where it is (leave them out to search the whole video). Priced at 1 token for each 10 seconds searched. It answers with a job_id: the clips come into the chat by themselves when done (about a minute). For where a job is, or to stop it, use sound_extraction_status with the job_id. The same request again answers the job already made and charges nothing. Clips are split where the sound goes quiet, which is a suggestion: music or speech under the sound can leave traces.

again.description: true only when the person asks to run the same extraction again (charged again).

end_seconds.description: Optional, where it ends, in seconds.

sound.description: The sound to pull out in a few words, e.g. "mechanical keyboard clicks".

start_seconds.description: Optional, where the sound starts in the video, in seconds.

video_url.description: The video in this chat by its file id or name, or an https link.
